summary: Align the email signup option with the provider buttons and explain the email-verification and passkey steps before account creation.
userImpact: Continue with email is a full-width option with an email icon, matching the provider choices.
Signup explains the required passkey step before requesting a verification email.
security: No password signup, credential, session or account-recovery authority changes; passkeys remain the existing email-account authentication method.
documentation: Signup and email-account page copy document the existing verification and passkey sequence.
knownLimitations: UI and protocol fixtures do not prove hardware compatibility, live email delivery, lost-passkey recovery or staging E2E signup.
rollback: Restore the prior frontend-host package and frontend image; no data migration.
validation: Focused UI tests cover email-option semantics, unsupported browsers, expired links and cancelled passkey prompts; backend protocol fixtures are qualified separately from real-provider acceptance.
